Workplace planning, interior design and build & fit-out — take the stage you need, or bring us the whole project from brief to move-in.

Let’s talk about your space ↗
ONE TEAM, THREE SERVICES

Plan it. Design it. Build it.

Most workplace projects pass through the same three stages. When one team carries the brief through all of them, less is lost at each handover.

You can work with us on a single stage — a brief before you sign a lease, a design for your own contractor, or a build from someone else’s drawings — or on the whole project as design and build.

01 / PLAN

Workplace planning

Turn how your team actually works into a brief, a space requirement and a layout that fits.

Includes

  • Working-pattern review
  • Space requirement schedule
  • Building and site review
  • Test-fit layouts
Explore workplace planning ↗
02 / DESIGN

Interior design

A design direction, space-by-space layouts and detailed specifications ready for pricing and build.

Includes

  • Concept and material direction
  • Furniture and lighting layouts
  • 3D views of key spaces
  • Drawings and specifications
Explore interior design ↗
03 / BUILD

Build & fit-out

One accountable team for scope, programme, site works, services and a documented handover.

Includes

  • Itemised scope and pricing
  • Civil, interior and MEP works
  • Site management and reporting
  • Testing, snagging and handover
Explore build & fit-out ↗

WHY ONE TEAM

Fewer handovers. Clearer decisions.

01

The brief stays intact

The people who heard your priorities at the start are still involved when they turn into details on site.

02

Cost is visible early

Design is checked against the budget as it develops, so pricing does not arrive as a surprise at the end.

03

One point of contact

A single team answers for the design and the build, so questions do not fall between consultants and contractors.

FAQS

Questions we are often asked.

Something else on your mind? Ask us directly ↗

Can we work with you on just one service?＋

Yes. Each service stands on its own: a planning brief you can take to any designer, a design any qualified contractor can build, or a build from another designer’s drawings.

What is design and build?＋

A single team takes the project from brief to handover — planning, design, pricing and construction — under one agreement and one point of contact.

What do you need from us to get started?＋

A floor plan or approximate area, team size, your timing and a budget range if you have one. None of it needs to be final.

Where are you based?＋

Our studio is at 18, Buddha Vihara Rd, Cox Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560005. Tell us where your space is and we will discuss how we can support it.

How do we start?＋

Send a short enquiry with a few details about your space. We will reply to arrange a first conversation about your brief and the right next step.

LET’S MAKE SPACE

Planning, design or build — or all three. Share a few details and we will suggest a sensible next step.
